subject: [RFC PATCH v2 04/18] mm: count the pages waiting for a grace period

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch adds a new counter, NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES, to track pages waiting for an RCU (Read-Copy Update) grace period. These pages have refcount 0 and are not on the free lists, making them invisible to existing counters. The patch updates several functions in the mm module to include this new counter in various statistics, such as /proc/vmstat and show_free_areas(). This change is a preparation step for freeing these waiting pages sooner when they hold back needed memory.
